model: N independent equal-weight circular complex Gaussian looks of a 2x2 circular-basis covariance; sample covariance = mean over looks; R = a_hat/b_hat, m_hat = sqrt((a_hat-b_hat)^2 + 4|c_hat|^2)/(a_hat+b_hat). Speckle only.
reference: Santalla del Rio et al., IEEE TAP 54(7), 2006 (santalla2006)
validity: a (DOP, CPR) pair is simulated only if DOP >= |q|, q = (CPR-1)/(CPR+1)

columns.p_cpr_gt_crit: P(R > crit_95), crit_95 the one-sided 95 % point of F(2N, 2N)
columns.p_joint_selection: P(m_hat < 0.13 AND R > 1) -- the joint screen
columns.p_joint_and_significant: P(m_hat < 0.13 AND R > crit_95); zero by the sample identity m_hat >= |1-R|/(1+R) whenever crit_95 > 1.2989, i.e. N < 80
